summary: Borr Drilling Ltd announced an any-and-all cash tender offer for its 10.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2028 (CUSIP 100018 AA8) and a partial cash tender offer for its 10.375% Senior Secured Notes due 2030 (CUSIP 100018 AB6), via its subsidiary Borr IHC Limited. The offers are funded by a Financing Transaction and cash on hand. Holders tendering by the Early Tender/Consent Deadline receive $50 early tender payment including a $2.50 consent payment per $1,000 original principal. The 2028 Notes total consideration is determined by fixed spread +50bps to a 2% UST due Nov 2026; 2030 Notes total consideration is $1,060. The company seeks consents to amend indentures. This is a liability management exercise; watch for participation rates and proration on 2030 notes.
